title: 2026 UK ETS SAF fossil comparator 94-to-89 option QA

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel

facts.source_fact: The current UK ETS fossil fuel comparator for SAF eligibility is 94gCO2e/MJ.
The current 94gCO2e/MJ comparator comes from the RTFO sustainability criteria.
The EU ETS also uses 94gCO2e/MJ according to the consultation.
The consultation describes 89gCO2e/MJ as a more accurate baseline for aviation fossil kerosene.
ICAO also uses 89gCO2e/MJ for lifecycle savings calculations of CEF according to the consultation.
Changing from 94 to 89 would lower the assumed baseline GHG emissions of fossil kerosene.
The Authority is considering adopting the 89gCO2e/MJ SAF Mandate comparator.
Comparator choice affects calculation of emissions savings for SAF eligibility.
The 89gCO2e/MJ value is a consultation option for UK ETS, not the current UK ETS comparator.
